tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Vellum: raised panels, sidebars, the T-account body, table headers. Text tokens all read on it.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Pressed and selected fills, chips, the quiet button's hover. Only ink-1 and ink-2 carry text here.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverse ground: the primary button, the terminal frame in light theme, one dark band per page at most.

tokens.name: line-1
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and sections. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, quiet buttons, chips with an edge). 3:1 on surface-0 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-1
tokens.usage: Primary text, the mark, the wordmark's letters, rules. On surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, table body text. On surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: captions, metadata, placeholder. On surface-0 and surface-1 only (4.6:1 on vellum).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and marks on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: coin
tokens.usage: The coin: the brand's one colour. The filled eye, the coin-o, the coin button, a single highlight per view. As a fill or a mark at 24px+; for small text use coin-text.

tokens.name: coin-text
tokens.usage: Coin as text: negative amounts, differences, the word Short or Over. On surface-0, surface-1 and coin-tint.

tokens.name: coin-tint
tokens.usage: Background for a row or cell with a difference. Text on it uses coin-text or ink-1.

tokens.name: on-coin
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a coin fill (the coin button). 4.6:1 light, 5.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: gilt
tokens.usage: Gold leaf: the coin as money in illustration, and the held (not yet posted) status mark. Never body text in light theme.

tokens.name: gilt-text
tokens.usage: Gilt as text: the word Held, pending counts. On surface-0, surface-1 and gilt-tint.

tokens.name: gilt-tint
tokens.usage: Background for held rows and the held tag.

tokens.name: verdigris
tokens.usage: Agreed and balanced: the balanced coin, a matched pair, a parity check that passed. Also as text on surface-0, surface-1 and verdigris-tint.

tokens.name: verdigris-tint
tokens.usage: Background for an agreed row or the balanced tag.

tokens.name: lapis
tokens.usage: Notes, links, the selected row's marker, a query's path, annotations. Text on surface-0, surface-1 and lapis-tint.

tokens.name: lapis-tint
tokens.usage: Selection background; the note's ground when it needs one.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: grid-major
tokens.usage: Graph paper, major lines (every 5 cells). Only inside the Sheet element; never a page background.

tokens.name: grid-minor
tokens.usage: Graph paper, minor lines. Only inside the Sheet element.

tokens.name: term-ground
tokens.usage: Terminal and TUI background, both themes: the terminal is always dark.

tokens.name: term-ink
tokens.usage: Terminal text on term-ground (14:1).

tokens.name: term-dim
tokens.usage: Terminal secondary text and hints on term-ground (6:1).

tokens.name: term-coin
tokens.usage: Terminal: the coin glyph, negatives and differences on term-ground (5:1).

tokens.name: term-ok
tokens.usage: Terminal: agreed and balanced on term-ground.

tokens.name: term-gilt
tokens.usage: Terminal: held, pending, warnings on term-ground.

tokens.name: term-note
tokens.usage: Terminal: selection marker, links, notes on term-ground.

tokens.name: term-line
tokens.usage: Terminal: frame lines and dividers.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page at most: the website hero.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on the website and docs.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Reads cost no API calls. A sync appends; it never overwrites.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every change Xero reports becomes a new version in the record.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary text, table descriptions, help text.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Every amount, account code and date. Tabular figures, right-aligned in columns.

styles.name: figure-total
styles.usage: Totals, sitting on a double rule.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels and annotations. Set in capitals in the source text.

spacing.note: A 4px base. The mark is drawn on a 96 grid; at 48px one mark unit is 2px, so its parts land on this scale.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, coin glyph to word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between tight inline items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding (vertical 8, horizontal 12); button padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on phones; the page gutter's minimum.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between major page sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Website section rhythm.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Website hero padding.

radius.note: Square by default, like a drawing board. The only round thing is the coin.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default: panels, tables, sheets, rules.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Popovers and the terminal frame.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: The app icon tile only.

tokens.name: radius-coin
tokens.usage: The coin: status glyphs, the coin-o, avatars.

tokens.name: rule-hair
tokens.usage: Row dividers (line-1).

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: The T-account's brow and stem; a section's top rule (ink-1).

tokens.name: rule-double
tokens.usage: The double rule under a total (CSS border-style double at 3px).

shadow.note: One shadow, for things that float. Everything else uses rules.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the command palette.
